title: NumPy as Synth Engine (PyTheory)
summary: A framework by Kenneth Reitz that treats NumPy arrays as audio buffers for mathematical music synthesis. It enables pure code-based composition and physical modeling of instruments without the use of audio samples.
research_notes: Demonstrates the Karplus-Strong algorithm for plucked string synthesis using only NumPy and standard Python libraries.

evolution.summary: The project culminated in the release of 'Interpretations', a 24-track album rendered entirely via Python scripts. It has expanded to support complex microtonal tuning systems and real-time algorithmic generation.
